title: SAFEWORLD: Geo-Diverse Safety Alignment
findings: Current LLMs, including GPT-4-turbo, struggle to generate appropriate and safe responses for queries involving geo-diverse norms, which include culturally-specific religious rules. The authors' fine-tuned model, SAFEWORLDLM, demonstrates superior performance in aligning with these diverse cultural and legal guidelines, outperforming even advanced proprietary models.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures the ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate responses that are compliant with geo-diverse cultural and legal standards. This includes adherence to religious norms and sensitivities, which are treated as a component of cultural safety. A specific example used is the sacred status of cows in Hinduism and the associated regional laws in India.
